//setup: Save as .github/hooks/usage-tracking.json (repo/cloud agent - must be on the default branch) or ~/.copilot/hooks/usage-tracking.json (user-level, CLI). GitHub Copilot delivers each event as JSON on stdin, so these command hooks pipe it to the 'usagetracker' CLI - same path as Claude Code. Requires 'usagetracker' on PATH (run 'usagetracker init' first). Identity comes from the daemon's Entra token; no USER_EMAIL. Event names use Copilot's canonical camelCase; PascalCase aliases (SessionStart, PreToolUse, ...) also work for VS Code compatibility.
